name: Sowipu Content Unlock
author: sssfkassr

sections.description:
Sowipu Content Unlock is a tool for digital humanism. It implements the spiritual principle of generosity (Dana) directly into WordPress. Instead of a conventional paywall, this plugin uses a model of collective unlocking: once a reader makes a donation, the protected content becomes freely accessible to all visitors for 48 hours.

Key Features

  • Dana Support: Collective unlocking for the community.
  • SEO Preservation: Googlebot sees a teaser (150 chars) for indexing.
  • Bot Defense: Blocks aggressive scrapers like FacebookBot.

Deutsch

Social Wisdom Publishing implementiert das spirituelle Prinzip der Großzügigkeit (Dāna) direkt in WordPress. Anstatt einer herkömmlichen Paywall nutzt dieses Plugin ein Modell der gemeinschaftlichen Freischaltung: Sobald ein Leser eine Spende (Dāna) leistet, wird der geschützte Inhalt für die nächsten 48 Stunden für alle Besucher der Website frei zugänglich.

Upgrade

The Advanced version offers custom branding and layouts. Available at: https://die-dorettes.de
sections.installation:
1. Upload the folder sowipu-content-unlock to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin in the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Configure settings under ‘Settings > Sowipu Unlock’.
sections.faq:
What happens after 48 hours?

The content is automatically locked again until a new patron makes a Dana gift.

short_description: Protects content with the Dana principle. Enables collective unlocking for 48h after a donation and protects against automated scraping.
